density_unavailable_policy: If the training-fold COMMON universe is smaller than a requested fixed K, mark that density unavailable; never silently cap K.

marker_rank.selection: filter static physical-bin rank to fold-eligible COMMON markers then take its prefix

confirmatory_decision.positive_effect_point_exceeds_SESOI: conditional 95% block-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND point delta_Q2 >= 0.01; this is not a practical-importance claim
confirmatory_decision.practical_equivalence: conditional 90% block-bootstrap CI lies entirely in [-0.01, 0.01]

bootstrap.conditioning: conditional on fitted OOF predictions; excludes retraining/tuning variance

multiplicity: Primary family contains only DTF1/blocked/250K-to-COMMON_ALL/delta_Q2; no adjustment. Trait 748 is preregistered replication.
